summary: This article is about the creature. For the item set, see Kargaeda (set). Kargaeda is one of the gryphons trained by Varallion that can be found with him in Coral Aerie. He is a rare, tropical breed with dark plumage highlighted by streaks of vivid orange. He is noted as the patriarch of the Coral Aerie gryphons. He has both lightning and wind-based attacks during combat and he only appears in hard mode.
